inputs.goal: remediate CVE-2026-1234 across the payment services estate

ingest.advisory: CVE-2026-1234 is a critical vulnerability in the payment services estate affecting transaction processing components. Immediate remediation required across all active payment service nodes. Vulnerability allows unauthorized transaction manipulation and requires patching of core payment processing libraries. All affected systems must be isolated, patched, and validated before reconnection to production environment. Human sign-off required post-validation.

prioritize.intake.summary: Critical vulnerability CVE-2026-1234 requires immediate patching of all active payment service nodes. Isolate affected transaction processing components, apply core library patches, validate remediation, and obtain human sign-off before reconnecting to production environment.

prioritize.review.output: CVE-2026-1234 is critical and affects three payment service nodes (payment-service-node-001, payment-service-node-002, payment-service-node-003). All nodes are currently affected and require immediate patching. Isolation, patching, validation, and human sign-off are required before reconnection to production.
